$comment: Committed TEMPLATE — schema and placeholders only. Copy to .ai-config/upstream.json (gitignored) and fill in your upstream path and the real term list. The real terms are deliberately NOT committed: projectTerms lists the customer, product and vendor names this workspace must never ship, so committing it would publish the exact vocabulary the gate exists to keep out. scripts/workspace-drift.js falls back to this file when the local one is absent and says loudly that the result is not authoritative — a scan against placeholders proves nothing. Both config files are in `ignore`: a terms file necessarily contains its own terms, so scanning it only ever reports itself. The guard that this template stays placeholders-only is tests/_lib/upstream-config.test.js.
